title: 3-Ingredient Brown Sugar Cookies
creator: Julies food
cookTime: 10-12 minutes per the video; the creator's batch took about 20 minutes (a commenter says 10-12 minutes works for smaller balls)
instructions: Step 2: Stir 1/2 cup softened butter and 1/2 cup packed brown sugar together until completely combined.
Step 3: Add 1 cup all-purpose flour and mix into a dough (no eggs).
Step 4: Roll the dough into balls by hand and place them on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Step 5: Press each ball down a little.
Step 6: Bake 10-12 minutes for smaller balls; larger cookies like the creator's may need up to about 20 minutes. Let cool a bit before eating.
notes: From a Julies food Facebook reel (video title '3 ingredient cookies'). The caption is empty; the recipe comes from the creator's spoken narration, with details confirmed in her comment replies (packed brown sugar, all-purpose flour, 350°F, about 8 cookies at her size). Texture is soft, and they are not butterscotch-flavored; she says they taste like a shortbread cookie. Creator-approved variations: chopped pecans, cinnamon (snickerdoodle-style), chocolate chips, Splenda brown sugar, using the dough as a tart shell, or eating it as edible cookie dough. Popular commenter add-ins: a splash of vanilla or almond extract, or cinnamon. Tip: some commenters reported the dough was too dry to come together; packing the brown sugar firmly and using truly soft butter helps. The creator suggests red and green sprinkles or decorations for Christmas.
